content.text: Quick checks on empty-trace and audit robustness corners:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import algo, fab, exact
prof = {"groups":1,"jitter_ps":[0],"measurements":[]}
fabric = {"n":2,"interval_ns":10,"slice_ns":40,"offset_ns":0,"drift_ppb":[5,0],
 "heat":[],"anchors":[[0,0,1]],"links":[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]],"delay_ns":[5,5],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}],
 "slices":[[0]],"blackouts":[],"guards_ns":[3],"reconfig_ns":0}
F = fab.Fab(fabric, None, build=False)
m = exact.calib_model(prof)
# R=0 empty trace
out = F.replay(3, {"rounds":0,"rates_ppb":[],"bias_ps":[0],"sends":[],"lost":[],"reboots":[],"queries":[0]}, m)
print('R0:', json.dumps(out))
# audit robustness: many junk proposals
p = algo.compile_plan(prof, fabric)
assert algo.audit(prof, fabric, p) == {"valid": True}
junk = [
  {}, {"status":"ok"}, {"status":"ok","profile":p["profile"]},
  p | {"bounds_as": None}, p | {"pred": []}, p | {"peaks_as": p["peaks_as"]*2},
  p | {"age_rounds": [[[True]]]}, p | {"bounds_as": [[10**30, None],[0,0],[0,0],[0,0]]},
  p | {"pred": [[[0,-1],[0,0]],[None,None],[None,None],[None,None]]},
  {"status":"inconsistent","cycle":[]},
  p | {"period_rounds": None},
  p | {"warmup_cycle": -1},
]
for j, prop in enumerate(junk):
    r = algo.audit(prof, fabric, prop)
    assert r == {"valid": False}, (j, r)
print('junk audits ok')
PYEOF
